item.title: AI-MarkDone FAQ - ChatGPT Reader, Markdown Copy, Privacy, Backup
AI-MarkDone Features moved to the Manual
AI-MarkDone Manual
item.description: AI-MarkDone is a ChatGPT browser extension. It is built around the repeated pain points that show up in study, research, and work, with one direct goal: make ChatGPT dramatically more efficient to use.

item.title: ChatGPT Reader mode in AI-MarkDone
item.description:
What this solves

The ChatGPT page is good for continuing a conversation. It is not always good for reading one dense answer. Long paragraphs, formulas, tables, and code blocks can crowd the chat view.

item.title: Copy ChatGPT formulas as LaTeX, MathML, PNG, or SVG
item.description:
What this solves

Formula copy is easy to get wrong. You may need LaTeX for notes, MathML for Office, or an image asset for slides and documents.

item.title: Copy ChatGPT to Markdown with AI-MarkDone
item.description:
What this solves

ChatGPT’s built-in copy action is not always enough. You may want Markdown, but get citation noise, flattened tables, or formulas that need cleanup.

item.title: Dynamic annotations
item.description:
What this solves

When asking ChatGPT to revise a long answer, “make it better” is usually too vague. You often know the exact sentence or paragraph that needs work.

item.title: Export ChatGPT to Markdown, PDF, PNG, or ZIP
item.description:
What this solves

Some answers need to leave ChatGPT: notes, shared documents, archives, or images. Each destination needs a different format.

item.title: Google Drive backup
item.description:
Use this when

Your bookmarks have become real working material, and you want a safer copy before reinstalling the browser, switching machines, or cleaning extension data.

item.title: Import and export
item.description:
Use this when

You are reinstalling the browser, clearing extension data, moving to another device, or simply want a copy before reorganizing bookmarks.

item.title: Install and refresh ChatGPT
item.description:
What this solves

AI-MarkDone installs in the browser and adds its toolbar to the ChatGPT page. After installation, the extension needs the current page to load again so it can recognize the conversation and message positions.

item.title: Old directory entry note
item.description:

item.title: Partial copy
item.description:
Use this when

You only need a small part of an answer, and you do not want code, tables, or formulas to break while copying.

item.title: Partial copy and Sticky have moved
item.description: This old entry stays here so previous links do not break.

item.title: Save ChatGPT answers with bookmarks and folders
item.description:
What this solves

Some answers are not ready to export immediately, but you know you will need them later. A browser bookmark saves the whole conversation, not the exact message.

item.title: Settings reference
item.description:
Use this when

You already know what AI-MarkDone can do and want to tune it to your habits. This page does not expose internal setting keys. It uses the real labels shown in Settings and explains what changes when you turn something on or off.

item.title: Sticky excerpts
item.description:
Use this when

You are reading a long answer and a few passages may matter, but you have not decided what to save, copy, or ask about yet.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Toolbar does not appear

Start with the simple checks:

  1. Make sure you are on the ChatGPT page.
  2. Refresh the ChatGPT tab.
  3. Open the browser extension manager and confirm AI-MarkDone is enabled.
  4. Check that the extension can access the current site.
  5. If ChatGPT has just loaded or updated, wait for the page to settle and check again.
